title: Easy to Drive and Handle
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly describe the car as easy to drive and handle, with a few examples shifting to difficulty operating the infotainment or navigation system.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise straightforward driving, simple handling, and an overall easy-to-use feel.

negative.summary: The negative review focuses on the infotainment system being hard to operate and not intuitive.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the navigation system being hard to operate, but the examples are insufficient to confirm overall sentiment beyond that statement.

limitations: Sampled fragments are heavily concentrated on short statements about ease of driving, so detail on specific handling traits is limited.
A small number of examples refer to infotainment or navigation usability rather than driving or handling, so the topic blends related but distinct ease-of-use subjects.
The examples are stratified samples rather than a representative cross-section of all reviews.
